title: Customized Tampa Heights Private Brewery Tour by Golf Cart
blurb: By booking our tour, up to five guests are provided pickup, drop off and transportation between up to five breweries. There are five breweries in The Heights pre-selected, but riders have the option to modify their trip from a full list of locations. All riders must be 21 years of age or older. This tour lasts 2.5 hours including pick up and drop off. This tour provides the transportation in a fun and unique way to see the City of Tampa and visit your choice of breweries.
